flows:
Navigate to https://www.meteoblue.com/en/weather/maps/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First assert the Weather Radar option in Popular Maps is in sequential keyboard focus order.
If a consent dialog appears, @v16:"use Manage options and Confirm choices".
Select Weather Radar with Tab and Enter.
Verify the map switches to Weather Radar.

summary:
A consent dialog was visible over the map. The instructions specifically said to use Manage options and Confirm choices when that dialog appeared, but the run instead asserted that Weather Radar could not receive keyboard focus.
Restart the check, use keyboard navigation to choose Manage options and Confirm choices on the consent dialog, then verify that Weather Radar appears in the normal Tab order and select it with Enter.
